personality_one_liner: Shortest path to booking for new users; the ultimate relationship guardian and honest financial dashboard for recurring clients.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native margins (lg/xl). No dense dashboards; let data breathe. Use visual hierarchy instead of boxes to separate dashboard blocks.

do's: Use glass for sticky bottom CTA in configurations
Use glass for the bottom tab bar
Use glass for the global WhatsApp FAB background
dont's: No glass on simple list items
No glass on dashboard data cards to preserve readability

screens.name: Home (State 1: Visitor)
screens.purpose: Conversion page with the shortest path to configuration and strong trust signals.

states.loading: Centered spinner over a faded background.

screens.layout: Root is a ScrollView. Top: Hero section (glass overlay on home interior image) with one-line promise 'Aiuto in casa, in regola, in pochi tocchi'. Immediately below: Configurator entry card for 'Pulizie e stiro' (prominent, showing a price estimate natively). Below that: Other active categories (Babysitting, Driver, Artigiani) in a clean 2-column or list layout (DO NOT HIDE). Bottom: Trust signals section (Verified identities, Insured services, Real reviews, First-service guarantee) styled as a surfaceSecondary block with icon lists.

screens.name: Home (State 2: Recurring Client)
screens.purpose: Guard and manage the recurring relationship with the cleaner.

states.error: Error loading upcoming visits. Retry button.

screens.layout: Root is a ScrollView. Topmost: Relationship Cards (one per active cleaner). Each card is an elevated surface card. Content: avatar of cleaner on left, Name on right. Below avatar: 'Next visit: Giovedì alle 15:00'. Bottom of card: 3 'pill' buttons for 'Prenota di nuovo', 'Sposta', 'Messaggio'. If there's an issue (e.g., failed payment), a full-width warning/error banner sits inside the card at the top. Below the relationship cards: The standard catalog grid (Pulizie, Babysitting, Driver, Artigiani).

screens.name: Portafoglio (Client Dashboard)

states.loading: Skeletons for wallet numbers and progress bars.
states.empty: Illustration of a clean wallet with zero transactions.
states.error: Cannot fetch wallet data. Retry button.

screens.layout: 4 vertical blocks separated by '3xl' spacing. (1) Borsellino Card: 3 numeric highlights ('Caricato', 'Impegnato', 'Spendibile') with Spendibile the largest. Guided top-up button below, and a subtle text notice for 'in-progress top-ups' ('€100 in ricarica, disp. mercoledì'). (2) Limiti Legali: Annual €10,000 progress bar, plus Per-Cleaner €2,500 progress bars (with cleaner avatar). Show '75%' weighting explanatory note. At 80% filled, show a warning-colored upsell card ('Passa a un contratto domestico?'). (3) Attività e Documenti: List of upcoming services with committed vouchers, and a history section to download receipts/invoices. (4) Recupero Fiscale: Annual estimate card ('~€180 di contributi deducibili') with a 'Add external usages' manual button.

screens.name: Provider Dashboard
screens.purpose: Mirror of the client dashboard tailored to the worker's earnings and limits.
screens.layout: 3 vertical blocks. (1) Guadagni: Incoming sums with prominent credit dates ('Accreditati €48 da INPS il 15 Ago'). (2) Limiti Personali: Progress bars for €5k/year, €2.5k/family, and 280 hours. (3) Storico Lavoro: List of past jobs, reviews received, reliability score, and a toggle for 'Non disturbare'.

cleaner_avatar.alt: Portrait of a smiling cleaner in uniform

home_hero_bg.alt: Beautiful Mediterranean home interior with arches

instructions_to_main_agent: REUSE EXISTING THEME: Map the provided color hexes to the existing Expo theme in /app/frontend/src/theme where possible. If the existing theme uses different variable names, bridge them.
CRITICAL NAV: Implement a 4-tab bottom navigation (Home, Attività, Portafoglio, Profilo).
GLOBAL WHATSAPP: Implement a floating action button (FAB) reachable from every screen using number +393481136876.
NO REGISTRATION WALL: For Home State 1, the 'Pulizie e stiro' configurator MUST be fully usable without login, only asking for registration upon final confirmation.
RELATIONSHIP CARD: Treat the relationship card on Home State 2 as the crown jewel of the UI. It must look trustworthy, clear, and make the 3 actions (re-book, reschedule, message) frictionless.
PROGRESS BARS: For the Portafoglio and Provider dashboards, use dynamic progress bars. If a limit hits 80%, change the color mapping to `warning` and show the upsell prompt.
